text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm spinning up the release notes doc for tonight's deploy (02:00 UTC). Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/s/release-notes-2026-03-22
marie: thanks! i've added the executive blurb and the customer-facing bullets. can docs help with tightened microcopy? :eyes:
alex: @sue can you take the microcopy pass for the feature summary and the known issues section? keep it <2 lines each.
sue: on it. will push edits by 00:30 UTC. also flagging locale note for EU privacy copy.
jon: oncall — i'll be on standby for the 02:00 window. deploybot will be scheduled; i can run the rollback if needed.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: release/v2.14.3 -> production
deploy-bot: Window: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z (ETA ~15m)
marie: legal review needed for the billing-change line. @legal-bot any ETA?
legal-bot: Running a quick sweep now. Should have OK / suggested wording within 20m. If wording requires a hold, call it out here.
alex: if legal requests hold, we should delay by at most 1h. prefer to avoid slicing rollout; aim for full rollout for this one.
jon: rollback criteria we agreed on earlier: error_rate > 0.5% over 5m OR latency p95 increase > 300ms over baseline. If triggered, i'll run rollback command:
```
# rollback to previous stable tag
deploybot rollback --target release/v2.14.2 --reason "post-deploy regression"
```
sue: microcopy suggestions uploaded. Shortened the known-issue entry and added mitigation steps for customers.
marie: thanks @sue — i'm updating the internal announcement snippet. Quick preview:
"Team — rolling out v2.14.3 at 02:00 UTC. Key fixes: reduced cold-starts for embeddings, improved routing fallbacks. Standby: @jon. Rollback criteria: error spike or latency regression. See doc: <link>"
alex: LGTM. i'll pin the doc and schedule the deploybot cue after legal clears.
legal-bot: all clear on billing wording. suggested minor tweak to privacy line; updated doc.
alex: perfect. final timeline: 01:40 UTC notify ops, 01:50 run smoke tests, 02:00 deploy, 02:15 verify metrics, 02:30 begin canary to 100% if green. @jon you'll be primary rollback owner.
jon: copy. i'll post status updates in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
marie: i'll craft the internal announce and the RN micro-blurb for the general channel after 02:30 if green. otherwise i'll post incident note.
alex: thanks everyone. short checklist: pin doc, legal ok, deploybot scheduled, oncall ready, microcopy done. notify when pinned. :white_check_mark:
